strings.title: Silence in Room 4
strings.hint: Who would lose if the victim won the tender? Trace who disabled the room's camera minutes before the session.
strings.solvedText:
The culprit: rival engineer Issam Diab.

The major government tender was about to be awarded to the victim's company by a single point. Issam entered the empty meeting room before the session, disabled the camera, and put a concentrated dose of heart medication in the victim's water bottle, causing sudden cardiac arrest that would appear natural for a man his age. The victim collapsed during his presentation. The tender was postponed and later awarded to Issam.

His fingerprint on the water bottle, the purchase of the medication with a forged prescription, and the camera being disabled at a port known only to the organizing company's engineers, of whom he had once been one, proved his guilt.
strings.summary.text: During the opening of bids for a construction tender worth hundreds of millions, businessman Salim Dawoud collapsed at the table in Room 4 and died. It appeared to be a heart attack in an exhausted man in his sixties, until analysis revealed concentrated heart medication in his water, and the disabled camera showed that someone had staged the scene.

strings.scene.intro: A formal meeting room with water bottles placed in front of every seat. Only the victim's bottle contains traces of medication. The camera was disabled at its network port minutes before the session, leaving no recording of the critical moment.
strings.scene.photos[0].cap: The meeting table and water bottles
strings.scene.notes[0]: Concentrated heart medication found only in the victim's bottle
strings.scene.notes[1]: The camera was disabled at 09:52 at the network port
strings.scene.notes[2]: The victim was the favorite to win by a single point
strings.scene.notes[3]: Bidders' seats were adjacent, making the bottle easy to reach
strings.evidence[0].title: The Victim's Water Bottle
strings.evidence[0].desc: A concentrated dose of heart medication; a partial fingerprint on the cap does not belong to the victim.
strings.evidence[1].title: Disabled Camera Port
strings.evidence[1].desc: The cable was manually disconnected at 09:52. Finding the cabinet requires technical knowledge of the building's layout.
strings.evidence[2].title: Bid Ranking Table
strings.evidence[2].desc: The victim's bid had the lowest price and highest evaluation, beating Issam Diab by one point.
strings.evidence[3].title: Forged Prescription
strings.evidence[3].desc: The same medication was bought two days earlier using a prescription in the name of a nonexistent doctor.
strings.evidence[4].title: Room Entry Log
strings.evidence[4].desc: Issam entered early at 09:15, supposedly to "prepare his presentation," and remained alone for 12 minutes.
strings.suspects[0].name: Issam Diab
strings.suspects[0].alibi: "I was preparing my presentation slides in the room. Legitimate work."
strings.suspects[0].statement: Yes, I've competed with Salim for years, honorably. I used to work for the organizing company and know its building. That doesn't make me a killer. Every bidder has the right to arrive early to prepare. Someone who loses by one point appeals the result, not commits murder.
strings.suspects[1].name: Raouf, the Tender Secretary
strings.suspects[1].alibi: "I was with the entire committee the whole time."
strings.suspects[1].statement: My job is complete impartiality. I have no interest in who wins, and my salary stays the same. The camera failure was a technical problem I reported to maintenance. I don't even have access to the network port.
strings.suspects[2].name: Dalal, the Victim's Assistant
strings.suspects[2].alibi: "I was distributing bid files to the committee in full view of everyone."
strings.suspects[2].statement: Mr. Salim was like a father to me, and this tender was his lifelong dream. I bring him water every morning, which is why I will never forgive myself. But I didn't touch the bottle in the room. I put it down, then dealt with the files in front of dozens of witnesses.
strings.witnesses[0].name: Committee Member
strings.witnesses[0].statement: I noticed that engineer Issam was the first to arrive and the last to sit down. He kept moving near the presentation table where the water bottles stood.
strings.witnesses[1].name: Maintenance Technician
strings.witnesses[1].statement: The Room 4 camera port was disconnected manually. You can only open its cabinet if you know where it is. Few people do, mostly former employees.
strings.witnesses[2].name: Room Attendant
strings.witnesses[2].statement: I distributed sealed bottles half an hour before the session, then left. Whoever opened and resealed a bottle did so while I was away.
strings.folders[0].name: Incident reports
strings.folders[0].docs[0].title: Collapse Report
strings.folders[0].docs[0].body: An ambulance was called for a sudden collapse during an official session. The case became a criminal investigation after analysis.
strings.folders[1].name: Forensic medicine
strings.folders[1].docs[0].title: Toxicology report
strings.folders[1].docs[0].body: A concentrated dose of digoxin many times above therapeutic levels; cardiac arrest within minutes.
strings.folders[1].docs[1].title: Bottle Report
strings.folders[1].docs[1].body: Medication residue was found only in the victim's bottle. A partial fingerprint on the cap is being compared.
strings.folders[2].name: Interviews
strings.folders[2].docs[0].title: Issam Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[0].body: His early arrival and knowledge of the network port are critical. He evaded the question about the prescription.
strings.folders[2].docs[1].title: Secretary Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[1].body: His presence with the committee is documented. He has no network access privileges.
strings.folders[2].docs[2].title: Assistant Interview
strings.folders[2].docs[2].body: The external camera documented her distributing files throughout the relevant window.
strings.folders[3].name: Records
strings.folders[3].docs[0].title: Tender Record
strings.folders[3].docs[0].body: The victim's bid led by one point. His death postponed the session, and the tender was later awarded to Issam.
strings.folders[3].docs[1].title: Pharmacy Record
strings.folders[3].docs[1].body: Digoxin was purchased two days earlier with a prescription in the name of a doctor not registered with the medical association.
strings.folders[4].name: Confidential files
strings.folders[4].docs[0].title: Fingerprint Match
strings.folders[4].docs[0].body: The partial fingerprint on the bottle cap matches Issam Diab with high confidence.
strings.folders[4].docs[1].title: Lobby Camera Analysis
strings.folders[4].docs[1].body: A frame shows Issam leaving the network cabinet corridor at 09:53, one minute after the camera failed.
strings.reports[0].title: Benefit Report
strings.reports[0].author: Financial investigation unit
strings.reports[0].body: The only direct beneficiary of the victim's absence was the second-ranked bidder, who later received the contract.
strings.reports[1].title: Scene Report
strings.reports[1].author: Scene examination team
strings.reports[1].body: Disabling the camera, selectively poisoning the water, and arriving early form a chain of planning, not coincidence.
strings.notes[0].text: Who knows where the network port is? A former employee.
strings.notes[1].text: A single point = a motive worth hundreds of millions
